text: あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか　◎かくとう　×ゴースト

structure.jp: あいてから　うける
structure.en: that you take from the opponent

structure.jp: じぶんへの　こうか

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in うける comes before the thing it describes and tells you which effect is meant. あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか = 'the effect on yourself that you take from the opponent'.

patterns.name: 〜への
patterns.span: じぶんへの　こうか
patterns.explanation: へ means 'toward' and の ties it to the next word, so together they say who the effect lands on. じぶんへの　こうか = 'the effect on yourself'.
